verbatim_quote.original: Produce a concrete implementation plan: (1) transport choice per server (HTTP/SSE shim vs shared gateway) given opencode supports type:remote with url+headers, (2) localhost-only ports, (3) supervision (systemd user units with auto-restart), (4) config cutover order with rollback, (5) multi-session verification steps.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Produce a concrete implementation plan: (1) transport choice per server (HTTP/SSE shim vs shared gateway) given opencode supports type:remote with url+headers, (2) localhost-only ports, (3) supervision (systemd user units with auto-restart), (4) config cutover order with rollback, (5) multi-session verification steps.

extracted_decision.summary: Manager defines the required sections of the implementation plan: per-server transport choice, localhost-only ports, systemd supervision, cutover/rollback order, and multi-session verification.
extracted_decision.rationale: To ensure the plan covers all critical aspects of the MCP singleton rollout.
alternatives: Allow a narrower plan focused only on transport
Allow the architect to self-select plan sections
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Constrains the architect's freedom but ensures completeness; Requires more detailed planning before approval
